meaning: Counts flag any stock logged trial warning during the original S first-step call, including losing ISR trials. They do not identify the failed trial coordinates.
limits: The absolute source-weight sums bound modifications restricted to these recorded events/endpoints. They are NOT a bound on bias of the native trial algorithm: unlogged trials below1GeV, changed survival probabilities, and alternate random paths are not controlled. Excluding warning events is neither a physical correction nor a valid warning-conditioned resampling.
omitted_detail: Exact commands and runtimes remain external; all 104 channel counts, source/matched hashes, warning counts, endpoint and scale errors retained.
